name: Male
overview: Scripture reveals that God created male and female in His own image, establishing distinct yet complementary roles within creation, as seen in Genesis 1:27 and Genesis 5:2. The sample verses highlight the significance of male identity in relationships and leadership, including the example of Lot's respectful posture toward visitors in Genesis 19:1. Additionally, Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13 clearly define boundaries for male behavior, emphasizing the holiness and order God requires in male conduct and spiritual leadership.
